scripts.build:all: npm run build:packages && npm run build:parent && npm run build:kids
scripts.typecheck:all: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/parent && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/kids
scripts.lint:all: npm run lint && npm run lint --workspace=apps/parent && npm run lint --workspace=apps/kids
scripts.test:all: npm run test:run && npm run test:run --workspace=apps/parent && npm run test:run --workspace=apps/kids
scripts.schema:build: npm run schema:export && npm run schema:generate
scripts.docker:up: npm run schema:build && docker compose up --build
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run smarti dj runserver
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules packages/*/node_modules apps/parent/node_modules apps/kids/node_modules packages/*/dist
